answer: What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round. Written in a precise technical wording, minimal adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors.
